recommendation: Keep the commit. The current search behavior is already correct after the seed and later related decisions; this small source fix removes a directly related broken history-page anchor without reopening the search semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-16369 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It requested clearer documentation of number-search precision effects, exponent-form decimal searches if MnM allowed exponent decimals, follow-up clarification of decimal equality in FHIRPath, and explicit confirmation that integer searches are exact under the published search rules.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 13844, represented in git as 79c1c0b5cb433f8068e231bd3ab2378464654f41, which changed source/search.html to add exponent-form number search examples, exact comparison-prefix descriptions, and exact integer-search guidance. The current search.html still carries that behavior.
additional_context: FHIR-16874 supplied the prerequisite decision allowing exponential decimal forms. The August 2018 Zulip follow-up led to FHIR-17668 and FHIR-17669, which clarified significant-digit counting and sa/eb applicability for decimal versus integer searches. Current source/search.html reflects those later decisions. The remaining current defect was the build-scope source/history.html entry for GF#16369, which linked to search.html#decimal even though the relevant section uses #number.
reconciliation: Changed source/history.html so the FHIR-16369 release-history diff link uses search.html#number instead of the nonexistent search.html#decimal anchor. No substantive number-search semantics were changed.
source_changes: source/history.html: changed the FHIR-16369 R4 ballot history diff link from search.html#decimal to search.html#number.

related_jiras.note: Allowed exponential form for decimals, satisfying the prerequisite branch of the FHIR-16369 resolution.
